highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and expanded platform support.
highlights_body: The v4 preview line adds color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, zero-copy stream access, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It also changes several preview APIs and raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks that require the previous assembly version.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Tizen arm and x86 native packages are no longer produced after upstream toolchain requirements made those EOL targets unusable. Move Tizen deployments to the new tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 assets.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for Emscripten versions associated with .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed, and those target frameworks now produce a build error. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion type uses GR casing
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Replace direct uses of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo; its legacy equality members are no longer part of the primary API.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException when the offset does not fit in the native 32-bit value instead of truncating it. Use an in-range offset and migrate to the int-based API.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m147
bullets.detail: The bundled engine gains newer image orientation, HDR, wide-gamut, color filter, drop-shadow, raster, and codec behavior across the m132, m133, and m147 updates.

bullets.lead: Bundled image and font dependencies refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo to newer upstream releases.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design positions, named instances, palette selection, and per-color overrides for variable and color fonts.
SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences with durations into animated WebP output using span-based overloads.
New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions for explicit mipmap and filter selection.
SKStream.GetData() returns ref-counted SKData when the native stream can expose its backing data directly.

bullets.lead: New color, document, GPU, and filter APIs
bullets.detail: Adds CICP color-space creation, HDR color types, R16Unorm, SKDocumentXpsOptions, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and the HBColor value type.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution no longer crashes during Android startup
bullets.detail: Default font lookup now uses the managed font manager path and falls back to an empty typeface when no system font is available.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization is safe when its builder is collected first
bullets.detail: Disposal no longer flushes a finalized SKPathBuilder, preventing a finalizer-thread native crash.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives MAUI tab switches
bullets.detail: Reattached GL views retain their dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface and rendering blank.

bullets.lead: Variable-font span and glyph checks corrected
bullets.detail: Undersized variation buffers now report and copy the correct values, while SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a stack overflow.

bullets.lead: NanoServer initializes without a font subsystem
bullets.detail: Windows NanoServer now uses an empty font manager instead of crashing during the first SkiaSharp typeface initialization.
SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now ship linux-bionic assets for x64 and arm64 Android-hosted Linux environments.
Adds native packages for the official tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 runtime identifiers.

bullets.lead: Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload
bullets.detail: Apple NuGet libraries target version 26.0 instead of 26.2, avoiding an unnecessary requirement for the newest point-version workload.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Begins the v4 preview line with Skia m147, variable fonts, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It removes 32-bit Tizen assets, advances the assembly version to 4.x, makes out-of-range SKStream.Move(long) calls throw, refreshes libexpat and libpng, and fixes Android default typeface startup and SKGLView tab reattachment.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData(), fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple workload compatibility by targeting the base 26.0 platform version.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8 and adopts GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, while adding HBColor, XPS document creation, resource-specific GPU flushes, and shader mask filters. It also fixes NanoServer font initialization and refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, and zlib.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font shaping APIs, color font palette queries, and the HBColor value type, together with Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.
